reddit_quotes: I've used Wusthof Classic for 36 months. The build quality is evident the moment you hold it.
Wusthof Classic is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The Wusthof Classic community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my Wusthof Classic after two weeks. The marketing is better than the product.
